scripts.build:firebase: cd ../.. && npx vite build --mode firebase --config cloud_chamber/learn-vos/vite.config.js && BUILD=$(date +%s) && sed -i "s/learn-vos-v[0-9]*/learn-vos-$BUILD/" cloud_chamber/learn-vos/dist-firebase/sw.js && sed -i "s/\"version\": \"[0-9]*/\"version\": \"$BUILD/" cloud_chamber/learn-vos/dist-firebase/manifest.json
scripts.deploy: npm run build:firebase && firebase deploy --only hosting --project fitness-aos
